title: AI Intern
description: AI Intern – Generative AI, AI Agents & AWS Company: Datadives India Pvt. Ltd. Location: Remote Unpaid Internship Role: AI Intern Company Description Datadives helps businesses transform scattered data, manual processes, and fragile pipelines into reliable systems for analytics, automation, and AI. The team specializes in connecting diverse data sources, building cloud data platforms, and implementing data quality checks that enable organizations to trust their numbers. DataDives focuses on optimizing cloud workloads and costs while preparing robust datasets that power practical AI applications. Our expertise spans data engineering, cloud platforms, machine learning, Generative AI, and intelligent AI agents that automate complex business workflows. Datadives works with startups, enterprises, and technology firms that require strong engineering ownership and hands-on delivery. Based in India, we partner closely with clients to solve real-world data and AI challenges. Role Description As an AI Intern at DataDives India, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, and evaluate practical AI solutions using Python, Generative AI, AI agents, and AWS cloud services. This full-time, on-site role provides hands-on experience building intelligent applications, experimenting with Large Language Models (LLMs), developing agent-based automation workflows, and integrating AI with enterprise data systems. You will contribute to proof-of-concept development, internal AI products, and selected client projects, gaining exposure to modern cloud architectures and production-oriented AI engineering practices. Key Responsibilities - Assist in designing and developing AI agents capable of reasoning through tasks, interacting with tools and APIs, and automating business workflows. - Build and experiment with Generative AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, and structured outputs. - Explore AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AWS Bedrock Agents. - Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using document processing, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. - Work with AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, and CloudWatch. - Support the development of Python-based APIs, data processing pipelines, and AI-powered automation solutions. - Experiment with machine learning models, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation. - Test AI agent reliability, response accuracy, tool-calling behavior, latency, and cost efficiency. - Integrate AI applications with databases, APIs, enterprise documents, and structured or unstructured data sources. - Maintain code repositories, document experiments, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with engineers on technical solutions. Qualifications Required Skills - Strong foundation in computer science, programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. - Good working knowledge of Python, including functions, object-oriented programming, APIs, and common libraries. - Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation. - Basic knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI application development. - Familiarity with AI agents, including concepts such as tool calling, task planning, memory, and multi-step workflows. - Basic understanding of AWS cloud concepts and services such as S3, Lambda, IAM, and Amazon Bedrock. - Familiarity with SQL, REST APIs, JSON, Git, and collaborative software development. - Strong analytical thinking, debugging skills, and willingness to experiment with emerging AI technologies. - Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. Good to Have - Hands-on experience building AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar frameworks. - Exposure to Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, or other AWS AI services. - Experience with RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. - Familiarity with LLM APIs, function calling, structured outputs, and agent orchestration. - Understanding of multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and human-in-the-loop workflows. - Experience with FastAPI, Docker, Streamlit, or similar application development tools. - Knowledge of AI evaluation techniques, hallucination reduction, guardrails, and responsible AI practices. - Familiarity with AWS architecture, serverless applications, and cloud cost optimization. - Experience with personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions, or working AI prototypes. What You'll Gain - Hands-on experience designing and building real-world AI agents and Generative AI applications. - Practical exposure to AWS cloud services and enterprise AI architectures. - Opportunities to work on industry-focused AI proof-of-concepts and automation solutions. - Experience taking AI ideas from experimentation to functional prototypes. - Direct mentorship from experienced data engineers and cloud architects. - Exposure to production engineering practices, code reviews, documentation, and collaborative development. At Datadives, we are looking for curious builders who want to move beyond AI tutorials and learn how to engineer intelligent systems that solve real business problems.

title: ML/AI Intern
description: ML / AI Intern Organization: ATRISI (Applied Technology & Research Institute for Social Impact) Location: Bengaluru, India Type: Internship Team: Technical Build & Product #About ATRISI ATRISI builds institutional intelligence infrastructure for the AI-native era — through applied research, enablement programs (Amplify with AI, Resonance with AI), and platforms including JoaLLM and TWAI. We ship real systems, experiments, and deployable workflows — not slide-only pilots. This internship sits on the technical build track: hands-on ML and applied AI work that supports platforms, programs, and internal research — with mentorship and clear deliverables. Role summary We are hiring an ML / AI Intern to work on models, data, evaluation, and product-facing AI features inside the ATRISI ecosystem. You will run scoped experiments, document results, and help prototype capabilities such as RAG, retrieval, and workflow intelligence — with code review and guidance from senior builders. This is a builder internship on real codebases. It is not a passive research observer role or a student-facing program coordination role (see our Learning Experience Associate track for that). What you will do ML & model work - Support training, fine-tuning, or evaluation on well-scoped tasks - Benchmark models and summarize tradeoffs (quality, latency, cost) - Help with dataset prep, labeling guidelines, and data quality checks - Contribute reproducible notebooks or scripts (versioned, reviewable) AI product features - Prototype RAG, retrieval, or agent-style workflows aligned with platform and program needs - Run structured evals: accuracy, failure modes, edge cases, regression checks - Assist integrating model outputs into APIs or internal tools under senior review - Participate in code review and testing for AI-related changes Research & documentation - Write short experiment summaries for engineering and program teams - Capture learnings in internal notes or knowledge products - Support applied research pilots when they need ML instrumentation How we work - Async updates via GitHub, Notion, or agreed tools - Join working sessions when useful - Raise blockers, data issues, and scope risks early What we are looking for Must have - Pursuing or recently completed a degree in CS, AI, data science, or a closely related field - Strong Python and comfort with at least one of: PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face - Solid fundamentals: train/validation split, common metrics, overfitting, training vs inference - Ability to read documentation or papers and ship a small working experiment - Git discipline: clear commits, reproducible runs, honest reporting of results - Genuine interest in LLMs, RAG, or applied AI in products Strong signals (what we prioritize in review) - A GitHub or portfolio with ML projects (coursework, capstone, Kaggle, side projects) - A short write-up of one project: problem → approach → stack → what you learned or shipped - Evidence you care about evaluation, not only demos (“it runs once”) - Comfort picking tools (Python, Jupyter, HF, SQL, Docker) and learning the rest on the job Nice to have - Vector DBs, embeddings, or orchestration (e.g. LangChain-style) experience - FastAPI, Node, or light full-stack glue for wiring models to products - Builder-style work: deployed demo, RAG app, agent workflow, or Amplify-like capstone - Notebook, blog post, or open-source contribution Not the right fit if - You only want generic “AI awareness” or prompt-playground work with no code - You expect exclusively live teaching or cohort operations (that is a different role) - You cannot commit to regular async progress and documented deliverables What you will gain - Mentorship on production-minded ML and AI feature work - Exposure to a multi-platform AI-native ecosystem (platforms + programs + research) - Portfolio artifacts tied to real institutional and student-facing initiatives - A credible path toward ATRISI Fellowship product engineering, or research associate tracks for strong performers Logistics - Employment type: Internship (weekly availability discussed at apply) - Location: Bengaluru, India How to apply - ATRISI site (recommended): https://atrisi.org/collaborate/ml-ai-intern#apply - Email: analyst@atrisi.org — Subject: Application: ML / AI Intern — resume + GitHub/portfolio link + 1-paragraph project summary - Builder Challenge: https://atrisi.org/programs/amplify-with-ai/builder-challenge In the application, be ready to describe *an ML or AI project you built (or want to build here) in a few sentences — problem, approach, tools, and outcome.

Why Join TerraTern Impactful Work: Your analysis will shape real decisions that help people reach jobs and study options abroad. Professional Growth: Learn from the team and work on real business problems from day one. Entrepreneurial Culture: Share your ideas, test them and own the result. Collaborative Environment: Work closely with product, tech, sales and marketing in a team that likes to learn together. title: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern

We move fast, build with intent, and run lean. You'll embed directly with our Forward Deployed Engineers — the team that sits at the intersection of business problems and AI infrastructure. FDEs don't take tickets. They own a business outcome, figure out the system to solve it, and build it. As an intern, you'll work alongside an FDE on a live workstream (catalogue automation, O2C processing, performance marketing, or pricing) and go from discovery to shipped code. If you do well, we want to keep you. WHAT YOU'LL DO: IN 1 Year Work on a real agentic workstream — not a sandbox project. Your code will run in production. Help design and build LLM-powered workflows: prompt engineering, tool use, output structuring, eval loops. Write Python scripts and pipelines that connect APIs, process marketplace data, and trigger business actions. Build lightweight internal tools — dashboards, alert systems, data quality checkers — that ops teams actually use. Debug, iterate, and improve existing automation from first principles, not just patch symptoms. Document what you build clearly enough that someone else can extend it without you. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR. Strong Python fundamentals. You can write clean, working code without leaning on a framework to think for you Genuine curiosity about how LLMs work — not just how to call the API, but when to use them and when not to Problem-first instinct: you read a messy business situation and ask "what's the real constraint?" before opening your editor Comfort with ambiguity. APPLY IF You've built something with an LLM that actually does something useful — even if small You've used Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted dev tools as part of your actual workflow You've shipped something to a real user, even in a side project or college contex You can explain a technical decision in plain language to a non-technical stakeholde r. DO NOT APPLY IF You've only used LLMs via a UI and haven't written code against an API. You reach for a framework before you understand the problem. You need detailed requirements to start, and ask for more specs when things get unclear instead of making a cal l. WHAT YOU’LL GET Direct access to FDEs and the Head of Engineering — not an internship manager buffer Real ownership on a production workstream from day one Exposure to agentic system design, marketplace data infrastructure, and eCommerce operations at scale. Competitive internship stipend. At Opptra, we write down what we believe and hold each other to it. If this sounds like the work you've been waiting to do — we want to hear from you.
